# GenieCoupon

> GenieCoupon is a coupon and deals platform with 455 verified merchant stores across 10+ categories. Coupons are tested by hand before publishing.

## Key Sections
- [All Stores (A-Z)](https://geniecoupon.com/stores): Full merchant directory
- [Categories](https://geniecoupon.com/categories): Deals organized by category
- [Today's Coupons](https://geniecoupon.com/coupons): Currently active codes and deals
- [How It Works](https://geniecoupon.com/how-it-works): Coupon verification process
- [Blog](https://geniecoupon.com/blogs): Shopping guides and savings tips
